title: Canonical representation on sections over a torsor
statement: Let $V$ be a scheme, $\ell\in\mathbb N$, $P$ a finite group, and $c:Y\to V$ a finite etale $\operatorname{ULift}(P)$-torsor [def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. For a sheaf $F$ of $\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbb Z/\ell\mathbb Z)$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], set $B=F(Y)$ with scalars restricted along the inverse of $\operatorname{ULift}(k)\cong k$. Define the representation $N_F$ by $\rho(g)=F(g^{-1}:Y\to Y)$. Define $Q_F(W)$ to be the coefficient-lifted presheaf of equivariant locally constant functions on $W\times_VY$ for $N_F$ [def-weil-pbc-torsor-associated-module]. A natural module morphism $\alpha:F\to Q_F$ is normalized if $\alpha_Y(s)(\Delta(y))=s$ for every $s\in F(Y)$ and $y\in Y$, where $\Delta:Y\to Y\times_VY$ is the diagonal. All constructions use genuine section data and restriction maps; no choice from an unproved existence statement occurs.
